# anypoint_agent_instances (Data Source)

Lists all `Agent instances` (technology 'omniGateway', endpoint type 'a2a') in an environment.

Since the underlying API Manager list endpoint does not expose `endpoint.type`, this data source first lists every instance for the environment and then fetches each `omniGateway`-technology instance's details to keep only the ones with `endpoint.type = "a2a"`. For an environment with many API Manager instances this results in one extra API call per candidate instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anypoint_agent_instances" "agents" {
  org_id = var.root_org
  env_id = var.environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env_id` (String) The environment id where the Agent instances are defined.
- `org_id` (String) The organization id where the Agent instances are defined.

### Read-Only

- `instances` (List of Object) The list of Agent instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances))
